scope: Independent voicing and interval fixture. Low E/string 6 through high E/string 1; x means muted. Conventional C7 intentionally omits its fifth; every other entry includes all named chord tones. This does not approve anatomical hand poses.
auditNotes: C7 x32310 intentionally omits G and must explicitly declare omittedTones:[G]. Bmaj7 uses complete-tone x24342 rather than common fifth-omitting x2130x.
Matching a reference fret sequence is separate from proving the supplied notes, finger assignments, barres and rendered diagrams correct.
A repeated finger needs a declared same-fret barre; a barre may pass under a higher-fretted note, but may not block an open or lower-fretted sounding string.
